descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S21 Billing call time and model x10, and the same cells rerun with the primary model forced to fail (backup answers, same checks)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U16 Each billing call logs how long the AI call itself took, separately from the total, and which model answered (and whether it fell back to the backup); … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.1; UAT 3.9; TFA-94514 AC 7)
  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 1; TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U10 The code and the stated level agree ('99232 / Low complexity' fails). (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U11 No reasoning, hedges, code comparisons or arithmetic in the billing output. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U13 AI Check 2: every Problem, Data and Risk element quotes a sentence from the note or is left out: no supplied diagnoses, no 'intensive monitoring for toxicity' from a trough level, no 'critically ill' … (UAT TC-18 AI Check 2; UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4; TFA-92596 AC 3; TFA-92596 AC 4; TFA-94229 R8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given The ten AI Check 1 fixtures (S13 a1-a5, b1-b5) on the primary model; then the S03, S13 and S15 cells (28) on the local 4510 stack with the primary forced to fail (never dev)

When Run the billing step once per cell and read the diagnostics:list row after each call

Then Each call has durationMs, providerMs and the model recorded; calls over 30 s not explained by providerMs are flagged. In the backup pass each call records fellBackFrom and the backup model, and its output passes the same per-cell checks as on the primary

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Primary pass: recorded, not Pass/Fail (3.5): ms seen by the runner, durationMs, providerMs, model, fellBackFrom per call; flag any call > 30 000 ms where durationMs - providerMs > 5 000 ms for review with Vikram; a missing providerMs or model is a Fail (U16). Backup pass: fellBackFrom and the backup model must be recorded (missing = Fail, U16); …

Where it ran: dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
